method: Direct visual inspection of all 13 archived original-resolution images, question wording, references and saved responses; no new model inference

gqa:20911237.notes: The same skateboarder appears in two panels. Man/boy and skater name the same actor at different specificity; the scored errors do not establish failed perception.

gqa:20911182.notes: Buildings and street furniture support an urban scene, but city is a broad scene label with a strong prior; unsuitable as a precise visual contribution target.

gqa:20911211.notes: The actor rides a skateboard on a ledge; riding and skating are overlapping descriptions. Reject the reference-versus-answer contrast as semantically nonexclusive.

gqa:202218922.notes: A leafy plant in a decorated pot sits below the hanging pans. Plant and flower pot both describe plausible vertical referents; counter is also farther below.

gqa:202218897.notes: The container in front of the paper towel roll is visibly a transparent French press. The question calls it glass but labels paper as correct; retain original score only as evidence.

gqa:202218557.notes: The canisters left of the toaster include light and dark bodies with metallic rims. Metallic-and-white is not clearly true of the plural referent.

gqa:20542898.notes: The elephant is visible, but strength is a generic animal property rather than image-specific evidence. Exclude even though all saved answers are correct.

gqa:20542858.notes: An elephant behind a barrier is visible, but zoo versus a wildlife enclosure or sanctuary is not uniquely verifiable from this frame.

gqa:20543094.notes: The horizontal rail runs behind the visible elephant; no cow is present. The animal and barrier relation are directly visible.

gqa:20118949.notes: The photograph is monochrome and contains several ties and shoes. The unqualified pair is not unique, and grayscale similarity cannot establish matching physical colors.

gqa:20119174.notes: The clear umbrella appears to be flexible transparent film, but its exact material is inferred rather than verified. Exclude as a primary material-contribution case.

gqa:20118967.notes: The women in the foreground have stepping leg positions in a group moving toward the camera. Walking is visually supported, with ordinary static-image action uncertainty.

gqa:20434860.notes: Both a child at left and an adult at the rear are seated at the same table. People is a reasonable answer to who is sitting, so Boy to People is not a clean loss.

gqa:20434770.notes: The visible chair backs are yellow/tan, not white. That visible color alone falsifies the white-and-wooden conjunction without inferring material.

gqa:20435192.notes: The table boundary is cropped and the chair backs also contain rectangular regions. The contrast between whole-object furniture shapes is not a uniquely grounded label.

gqa:201713640.notes: The wall-mounted mirrored medicine cabinet occupies the upper-right of the frame; it is distinct from the round tabletop mirror. Right to Left changes a visible location. Mirror reflections are a retained caution.

gqa:201713599.notes: Within the visible bathroom frame, towels and mirrors are present, while no curtain or trash can is visible. This is a broad visible-absence control, not localized positive evidence.

gqa:201713271.notes: A bathroom sink, interior walls, mirror and fittings clearly establish indoors. Retain as a coarse scene control, not a fine-detail task.

gqa:202036755.notes: The pizza box has a white inner side and darker outer/back regions. White versus Brown may select different surfaces of the same container; exclude the apparent loss.

gqa:202036818.notes: Visible pepper pieces are green, while red circular toppings are pepperoni. Green color is sufficient to reject the red-and-cooked conjunction; no cooking-state judgment is needed.

gqa:202036902.notes: Numerous meat slices and yellow cheese patches occur across the pizza. The sausage and yellow-food referents are not unique, and some slices lie to the right of cheese.

gqa:201479357.notes: The white fork handle is exposed while its tines are partly underneath the chicken. Covered could mean partly occluded or wrapped/fully covered; Yes and No reflect different readings.

gqa:201479496.notes: A visibly breaded chicken portion is directly above the white fork in the tray. The meat and relation are clear at the archived image resolution.

gqa:201479334.notes: The white fork is visibly present at the front of the tray. Its presence makes the tablecloth-or-fork disjunction true, independent of any tablecloth; both saved No answers miss it.

gqa:201428959.notes: The white refrigerator stands to the right of the visible cardboard food boxes on the left counter. The relevant objects and left-right order are clear.

gqa:201428953.notes: The freezer compartment belongs to the same refrigerator to the right of the cardboard boxes. This is a paraphrase/entity-part control, not an independent visual task.

gqa:201428716.notes: Several possible plumbing/pipe-like objects occur by the sink and lower left. The unqualified pipe and its color cannot be uniquely identified.

gqa:201882905.notes: A black flat-screen television sits on the desk immediately right of the curtains. Television to Phone is a visibly different object-class prediction.

gqa:201883113.notes: Both hotel beds have visible quilted white bedding/comforters. The blanket term comforter is reasonable, so a gold No for planters-or-comforters is not a clean preserved control.

gqa:201882614.notes: The lit bedside lamp is at the far left edge of the image. Left to Right contradicts a clear image-coordinate location.

gqa:202257136.notes: Two dogs are visible at lower right. At least one is standing, but resting is a behavioral state that cannot be confidently excluded from a static scene; do not call this a clean gain.

gqa:202257249.notes: A cyclist is visibly mounted on a bicycle along the path. That rider makes the cyclists-or-men-riding existential true.

gqa:202257439.notes: Several people wear jackets, including the rider. Depending on the intended wearer, a bicycle can be beside or under that person; the referent is not unique.

gqa:20596219.notes: The foreground coat and the visible bin farther along the sidewalk both appear very dark/black. The gold No is visually plausible; small bin size and possible dark-hue variation remain cautions, so this is a tentative gain case.

gqa:20596541.notes: The pavement is dark gray, but clear puddles or reflections are not visible enough to distinguish damp from dry asphalt/concrete. Do not use the saved Wet score as visual confirmation.

gqa:20596493.notes: The clearly visible foreground coat is black/dark rather than tan; no visibly tan coat is identifiable in this frame. Retain as a broad color/absence control.

gqa:20644736.notes: A single visible cat looks toward the person or hand at left. Cat identification is supported directly; no fine inference about gaze direction is required to resolve the referent.

gqa:20644699.notes: A cat is plainly visible in the right half of the frame. This is a direct positive object-presence control.

gqa:20644755.notes: The person is heavily cropped: an arm enters from above, but legs and shoes fill the lower half. Top versus bottom depends on which body region defines position.

gqa:20911239.notes: The word skater strongly cues skateboard, while on could also refer to the ledge. Prefer more specific visual questions rather than promoting this easy lexical-prior control.

gqa:202218593.notes: The white paper-towel roll sits in the lower part of the image, behind the French press and beside the plant. Bottom is directly supported.

gqa:202218829.notes: The two hanging pans are directly in front of the right-hand window frame. Window is a clear spatial reference.

gqa:20543088.notes: The visible green bush is behind the barrier rails, so the fence is not behind that bush. The overlapping layers support No.

gqa:20434856.notes: A visible child at the left edge sits immediately next to the open pizza box and pizza. The existential near relation is supported without relying on age comparisons.

gqa:201479426.notes: The bread roll is split open with a visible cut interior, while the orange is whole. The contrast is visible and is not a necessary property of either food.

gqa:201429017.notes: The black stove/oven stands immediately left of the white refrigerator. This adds object identification to the refrigerator relation questions.

gqa:201883221.notes: No sink or basin is visible in front of the tall mirror left of the desk chair. Retain only as a broad visible-absence control; room priors and lack of localized target evidence must be considered.

gqa:202257420.notes: Bicycles are visibly present, which is enough to make the bicycles-or-fences question true regardless of fences. A simple positive presence control.

gqa:20644661.notes: A black cable visibly crosses the light paper sheets above and left of the cat. The object overlap supports Yes and provides a different task from cat presence.
